FINDING: DUPE_RESEARCH.json counts a lineup's ACTUAL as every entry in the full contest holding it (ALL copies, our own entry included) and predicts N x q. On our own lineups the reported actual/pred therefore includes one own copy per lineup. We entered no lineup twice (ATL_NO_OWNER_ENTRIES_GRADED.csv: 150/20/2 unique), so OTHER copies = all copies minus one per lineup located in the universe (the 150-max has 149 or 150 located; both bounds shown).
UNITS: unique-lineup units (one row per distinct owner lineup); entry-weighted and all-field panels are not computed here
MODEL_SIDE: N x q under independent entry is the expected ALL-copies count of a lineup; for one of our entered lineups the expected OTHER-copies count is (N-1) x q, which differs from N x q by q (negligible at these N)
CONSEQUENCE: B4 other-copies calibration on our lineups is ~1.01 (150-max), ~1.03 (20-max), ~0.70 (2-entry); the earlier all-copies figures (1.02 / 1.05 / 0.71) are not wrong as all-copies figures, but they are not other-copies figures. Score ties are a different thing and are not counted here. Three contests from one game: not a promotion basis.
